mainText: Home / PNR status Live railway journey tool PNR Status Check Enter your 10-digit PNR to see each passenger’s current status, coach, berth and chart details. Confirmation estimates depend on the connected provider and are available only for supported bookings. Your PNR is used only to fetch this result No login needed PNR status 10-digit ticket number 10-digit PNR number Check PNR status Check your PNR first, then choose ‘Check confirmation chance’ on a WL/RAC result. Optional estimate · Not a guarantee. Your PNR is used only to fetch this result Read each passenger’s current status first. A confirmation estimate is separate and does not give permission to travel. See an example PNR result Fictional example · Not a live ticket How to read a PNR result Booking status records the position when the ticket was booked. Current status is the latest status returned by the provider. Passengers on the same PNR can have different results. Example passenger A Booking status WL/9 Current status WL/7 Coach / berth Not supplied The waiting position moved from 9 to 7. This does not mean berth 7 or a confirmed ticket. Example passenger B Booking status WL/4 Current status CNF Coach / berth S2 / 15 This fictional result shows confirmed status and an allocation. It does not determine another passenger’s status. A confirmation percentage is a separate, provider-dependent estimate. It does not change the current status. An unavailable estimate does not mean 0%. Check the official record and applicable travel conditions before travelling. Read the full guide to PNR results → Understand CNF, RAC and waiting-list codes Read the result calmly What common PNR codes mean A booking code can change until chart preparation. Read the current status for each passenger, not only the original booking status. CNF Confirmed A confirmed accommodation. Coach and berth may appear after allocation. RAC Reservation Against Cancellation Travel is generally permitted with shared accommodation until a full berth becomes available. WL Waiting List Not confirmed yet. The final position can change until chart preparation. GNWL General Waiting List A common waitlist category linked to the journey and booking quota. RLWL Remote Location Waiting List Waitlist for certain intermediate or remote-location station quotas. PQWL Pooled Quota Waiting List A waitlist under a pooled quota shared by selected stations. TQWL Tatkal Waiting List Waiting status for a Tatkal quota booking. CAN Cancelled The passenger or ticket entry has been cancelled. Where to find your PNR and how to check it Three simple steps How this PNR checker works 01 Enter the ticket number Use the 10-digit PNR printed on the ticket or booking confirmation. 02 We request the latest record We ask the connected railway-data provider for the latest available status. 03 Review each passenger Check current status, coach, berth and whether the chart has been prepared. Where can I find my PNR? On an e-ticket, it normally appears near the top of the booking confirmation. It may also be present in the SMS or email received after booking. Private by design Your PNR is used to request your result. It is not included in our analytics. Questions travellers ask PNR status FAQs 0 1 How do I check my confirmation chances? Enter your PNR and check the result. For an eligible WL/RAC booking, select Check confirmation chance below the passenger details. The connected third-party provider supplies the optional estimate when available; coverage depends on the provider and booking. 0 2 Is the confirmation prediction guaranteed? No. It is a PNR-level estimate, not a separate score for each passenger or permission to travel. Check each passenger’s final status in the official railway record. 0 3 Why might no confirmation estimate appear? Predictions are not available for every booking. The option is shown for supported WL/RAC results when the feature is enabled. A provider outage or unsupported response can also make an estimate unavailable; your current PNR status remains separate. 0 4 What is a railway PNR number? PNR means Passenger Name Record. Indian railway reservations use a 10-digit number to identify the booking record. 0 5 Can PNR status change after booking? Yes. Waiting-list and RAC positions can change as passengers cancel or railway allocation changes, including around chart preparation. 0 6 What does chart prepared mean? It means the reservation chart for the train has been prepared. Check the current passenger status and official record for the final travel position. 0 7 Can I travel on a waitlisted ticket? Eligibility depends on the ticket type, final chart status and current railway rules. Do not rely on a generic answer—verify the final status through the official railway enquiry before boarding. 0 8 Does RailQ save my PNR? Your PNR is not included in our analytics. The number is used to request your result. title: PNR स्थिति ऑनलाइन देखें | RailQ
description: हर यात्री का PNR स्टेटस, कोच, बर्थ और चार्ट विवरण देखें। डेटा प्रदाता से समर्थित बुकिंग पर वैकल्पिक कन्फर्मेशन अनुमान माँगें।
mainText: होम / PNR स्थिति लाइव रेलवे यात्रा टूल पीएनआर स्टेटस चेक करें 10 अंकों का PNR डालकर हर यात्री की वर्तमान स्थिति, कोच, बर्थ और चार्ट विवरण देखें। कन्फर्मेशन अनुमान जुड़े प्रदाता पर निर्भर हैं और केवल समर्थित बुकिंग के लिए उपलब्ध होते हैं। आपका PNR केवल यह परिणाम लाने के लिए उपयोग होता है लॉगिन की जरूरत नहीं PNR स्थिति 10 अंकों का नंबर 10 अंकों का PNR नंबर PNR स्थिति देखें पहले PNR जाँचें, फिर WL/RAC परिणाम में ‘कन्फर्म होने की संभावना देखें’ चुनें। वैकल्पिक अनुमान · गारंटी नहीं। आपका PNR केवल यह परिणाम लाने के लिए उपयोग होता है पहले हर यात्री की वर्तमान स्थिति देखें। कन्फर्मेशन अनुमान अलग है और यात्रा की अनुमति नहीं देता। PNR परिणाम पढ़ने का उदाहरण काल्पनिक उदाहरण · लाइव टिकट नहीं PNR परिणाम में कौन-सी जानकारी पढ़ें? बुकिंग स्थिति टिकट बनते समय की जानकारी है। वर्तमान स्थिति प्रदाता से मिली नवीनतम स्थिति है। एक ही PNR में हर यात्री का परिणाम अलग हो सकता है। उदाहरण यात्री A बुकिंग स्थिति WL/9 वर्तमान स्थिति WL/7 कोच / बर्थ नहीं दिखाया गया प्रतीक्षा क्रम 9 से 7 हुआ है। इसका अर्थ बर्थ 7 या कन्फर्म टिकट नहीं है। उदाहरण यात्री B बुकिंग स्थिति WL/4 वर्तमान स्थिति CNF कोच / बर्थ S2 / 15 इस काल्पनिक परिणाम में कन्फर्म स्थिति और आवंटन दिख रहे हैं। दूसरे यात्री का परिणाम इससे तय नहीं होता। कन्फर्मेशन प्रतिशत एक अलग, प्रदाता-निर्भर अनुमान है। यह वर्तमान स्थिति नहीं बदलता। अनुमान उपलब्ध न होना 0% नहीं है। यात्रा से पहले आधिकारिक रिकॉर्ड और लागू यात्रा शर्तें जाँचें। PNR परिणाम की पूरी जानकारी पढ़ें → CNF, RAC और वेटलिस्ट कोड समझें स्थिति को आसानी से समझें सामान्य PNR कोड का अर्थ चार्ट बनने तक बुकिंग कोड बदल सकता है। केवल शुरुआती बुकिंग स्थिति नहीं, हर यात्री की वर्तमान स्थिति देखें। CNF कन्फर्म सीट कन्फर्म है। कोच और बर्थ आवंटन के बाद दिख सकते हैं। RAC रद्दीकरण के विरुद्ध आरक्षण आम तौर पर यात्रा की अनुमति होती है; पूरी बर्थ मिलने तक साझा सीट हो सकती है। WL प्रतीक्षा सूची अभी कन्फर्म नहीं है। चार्ट बनने तक स्थिति बदल सकती है। GNWL सामान्य प्रतीक्षा सूची यात्रा और बुकिंग कोटा से जुड़ी सामान्य प्रतीक्षा सूची। RLWL रिमोट लोकेशन प्रतीक्षा सूची कुछ बीच के या रिमोट स्टेशन कोटा की प्रतीक्षा सूची। PQWL पूल्ड कोटा प्रतीक्षा सूची चुनिंदा स्टेशनों के साझा पूल्ड कोटा की प्रतीक्षा सूची। TQWL तत्काल प्रतीक्षा सूची तत्काल कोटा बुकिंग की प्रतीक्षा स्थिति। CAN रद्द यात्री या टिकट प्रविष्टि रद्द हो चुकी है। PNR कहाँ मिलेगा और जाँच कैसे करें? तीन आसान चरण यह PNR चेकर कैसे काम करता है 01 टिकट नंबर डालें टिकट या बुकिंग पुष्टिकरण पर दिया गया 10 अंकों का PNR इस्तेमाल करें। 02 नवीनतम रिकॉर्ड माँगा जाता है हम जुड़े रेलवे डेटा प्रदाता से नवीनतम उपलब्ध स्थिति माँगते हैं। 03 हर यात्री की स्थिति देखें वर्तमान स्थिति, कोच, बर्थ और चार्ट तैयार हुआ है या नहीं—सब जाँचें। PNR कहाँ मिलेगा? ई-टिकट में यह आम तौर पर बुकिंग पुष्टिकरण के ऊपर दिखाई देता है। बुकिंग के बाद आए SMS या ईमेल में भी मिल सकता है। गोपनीयता पहले आपका PNR केवल परिणाम माँगने के लिए उपयोग होता है। यह हमारे एनालिटिक्स में शामिल नहीं होता। यात्रियों के सामान्य सवाल PNR स्थिति से जुड़े सवाल 0 1 कन्फर्म होने की संभावना कैसे देखें? PNR डालकर परिणाम देखें। पात्र WL/RAC बुकिंग के लिए यात्री विवरण के नीचे ‘कन्फर्म होने की संभावना देखें’ चुनें। उपलब्ध होने पर यह वैकल्पिक अनुमान जुड़ा तृतीय-पक्ष प्रदाता देता है; इसका दायरा प्रदाता और बुकिंग पर निर्भर है। 0 2 क्या कन्फर्म होने का अनुमान गारंटी है? नहीं। यह पूरे PNR का अनुमान है, हर यात्री का अलग स्कोर या यात्रा की अनुमति नहीं। आधिकारिक रेलवे रिकॉर्ड में हर यात्री की अंतिम स्थिति जाँचें। 0 3 कन्फर्म होने का अनुमान क्यों नहीं दिख सकता? हर बुकिंग के लिए अनुमान उपलब्ध नहीं होता। सुविधा चालू होने पर समर्थित WL/RAC परिणामों में विकल्प दिखता है। प्रदाता की सेवा या उत्तर में समस्या होने पर भी अनुमान नहीं मिल सकता; वर्तमान PNR स्थिति इससे अलग है। 0 4 रेलवे PNR नंबर क्या है? PNR का अर्थ Passenger Name Record है। भारतीय रेलवे आरक्षण में बुकिंग रिकॉर्ड पहचानने के लिए 10 अंकों का नंबर होता है। 0 5 क्या बुकिंग के बाद PNR स्थिति बदल सकती है? हाँ। यात्रियों के टिकट रद्द करने या रेलवे आवंटन बदलने से WL और RAC स्थिति, चार्ट बनने तक, बदल सकती है। 0 6 चार्ट तैयार होने का क्या अर्थ है? इसका अर्थ है कि ट्रेन का आरक्षण चार्ट तैयार हो गया है। अंतिम यात्रा स्थिति के लिए वर्तमान यात्री स्थिति और आधिकारिक रिकॉर्ड देखें। 0 7 क्या वेटलिस्ट टिकट पर यात्रा कर सकते हैं? यात्रा की अनुमति टिकट प्रकार, अंतिम चार्ट स्थिति और मौजूदा रेलवे नियमों पर निर्भर करती है। चढ़ने से पहले आधिकारिक रेलवे पूछताछ से अंतिम स्थिति सत्यापित करें। 0 8 क्या RailQ मेरा PNR सेव करता है? आपका PNR हमारे एनालिटिक्स में शामिल नहीं होता। नंबर परिणाम माँगने के लिए उपयोग होता है। यात्रा आगे बढ़ाएँ PNR देखने के बाद उपयोगी टूल्स लाइव ट्रेन स्थिति चार्ट तैयारी बर्थ पहचानें टूल का लिंक शेयर करें और समझें: निर्णय से पहले अपना PNR समझें निर्णय से पहले अपना PNR समझें वर्तमान स्थिति अभी की बुकिंग बताती है। कन्फर्मेशन अनुमान संभावित भविष्य का संकेत है, कन्फर्म बर्थ नहीं। हर यात्री की स्थिति अलग जाँचें। एक उदाहरण से समझें उदाहरण: यात्री 1 CNF है और यात्री 2 WL/5 है। बुकिंग स्तर का 80% अनुमान यात्री 2 को बर्थ मिलना नहीं बताता। यात्रा तय करने से पहले दोनों पंक्तियाँ जाँचें। केवल समझाने के लिए; वास्तविक बुकिंग नहीं। कन्फर्मेशन प्रतिशत समझें वेटलिस्ट में बदलाव समझें परिवार की मिली-जुली स्थिति समझें संदर्भ: Indian Railways: PNR enquiry and prediction notice · डेटा और अनुमान की प्रक्रिया · सुधार बताएँ क्या यह जानकारी उपयोगी थी? हाँ नहीं इस पेज की समस्या बताएँ समस्या की श्रेणी जानकारी स्पष्ट नहीं है जानकारी गलत हो सकती है टूल या लिंक काम नहीं करता अनुवाद या कैप्शन दिखावट या सुगम उपयोग समस्या भेजें PNR या यात्री विवरण न भेजें। यह फॉर्म केवल पेज का पथ और चुना उत्तर/श्रेणी भेजता है, URL क्वेरी नहीं। यह विज़िटर एनालिटिक्स या ट्रैकिंग कुकी उपयोग नहीं करता। परिणाम के बारे में और जानकारी PNR स्थिति: उपयोग की जानकारी उदाहरण: वेटलिस्ट संख्या बर्थ नहीं है उदाहरण में बुकिंग WL/9 और वर्तमान WL/7 का अर्थ प्रतीक्षा क्रम आगे बढ़ना है। 9 या 7 को आवंटित बर्थ नहीं दिखाना चाहिए। एक PNR होने पर भी हर यात्री की वर्तमान स्थिति अलग देखें। परिणाम में RAC है? Source-aware guidance English and हिंदी Compare the whole connection A connecting route is a timetable option, not a reservation. Check both train dates, the exact interchange stations and seat availability on every leg. Find a route with one train change Assess your transfer margin Check seats for both trains On this page What choosing VIKALP does Only select alternatives you can reach After an alternate is allotted A separate connection is a different plan Keep a clear decision record Low confirmation chances: compare alternatives in this order Read a connection across midnight correctly What the connecting planner does—and what it cannot promise Before paying for separate legs 01 What choosing VIKALP does VIKALP requests consideration for an alternate service; it does not guarantee a berth. Check the option and offered trains in your official booking history. RailQ’s assistant cannot submit the preference or confirm an allocation. Read the linked IRCTC terms before selecting services. 02 Only select alternatives you can reach Compare the exact departure station, date and arrival. A nearby station can still involve a long road transfer at a busy time. Write down the earliest time you can reach each alternative and the latest arrival you can accept. Remove choices that would miss an essential appointment. 03 After an alternate is allotted Recheck the PNR and the allotted train, including any changed station. IRCTC’s terms say passengers given alternate accommodation must not board the original train. Follow the cancellation conditions for the alternate allocation rather than assuming the original waiting-list treatment continues. 04 A separate connection is a different plan Booking two independent trains is not the same as receiving a VIKALP allocation. Work out the transfer yourself: scheduled gap, station change, platform access, luggage and delay margin. A short scheduled connection can become expensive if a missed train requires a fresh ticket or an overnight stay. 05 Keep a clear decision record Before travel, put the final train, station, date and transport plan in one private note. Remove obsolete reminders so you do not act on the abandoned plan. Verify the final booking again before leaving for the station. 06 Low confirmation chances: compare alternatives in this order Start with a different departure time, date or class on a direct service. Next compare nearby stations only if you can reach them comfortably. Then use the connecting-train planner for routes with one train change. Compare the whole journey: both ticket prices, station transport, waiting time and any overnight accommodation. A cheaper individual ticket can produce a more expensive or less practical overall trip. Find direct and connecting trains Check seats on each train Compare each leg’s fare 07 Read a connection across midnight correctly Illustrative timetable: the first train arrives on 20 October at 23:30 and the next leaves on 21 October at 02:15. The scheduled gap is 2 hours 45 minutes, not a negative interval. If the first train arrives 90 minutes late, only 75 minutes remain before the second train’s scheduled departure, before allowing for walking or a station change. This is an example, not an actual service or a recommended connection. Work through your transfer margin 08 What the connecting planner does—and what it cannot promise RailQ searches timetable options with up to one train change and displays the exact station codes, dates and scheduled gap. The minimum gap you select is your planning preference, not an official rule. Routes without complete timings or enough gap are omitted. A result does not confirm seats, reserve tickets or establish that you will catch the second train. Check live running separately near travel time. Check running status 09 Before paying for separate legs Verify the available class and passenger status on both trains, and review the terms in the authorised booking service. RailQ does not link PNRs or create refund protection. Do not assume that two independently purchased tickets receive the same treatment as an officially linked connecting booking. If a delay causes a missed connection, contact the booking service or railway staff promptly for the applicable process and evidence requirements. mainText: Home / Guides / GNWL vs RLWL vs PQWL vs TQWL: Meanings & Examples Practical journey guide GNWL vs RLWL vs PQWL vs TQWL: Meanings & Examples Compare GNWL, RLWL, PQWL and TQWL meanings with fictional ticket examples. Understand current PNR status and why codes cannot guarantee confirmation. Source-aware guidance English and हिंदी GNWL, RLWL, PQWL and TQWL at a glance These codes identify waiting-list categories. They do not promise a berth or tell you which ticket will confirm first. Read booking status, current status and chart status separately for every passenger. What are RLWL and PQWL? RLWL means Remote Location Wait List, linked to a remote-location quota. PQWL means Pooled Quota Wait List, linked to a quota shared by selected stations. Neither category alone tells you whether your ticket will confirm. Code meanings and fictional ticket examples Code / meaning What to understand Fictional booking → current status GNWL General Wait List General waiting-list category; the code alone does not establish a confirmation chance. GNWL 24 → WL 9 RLWL Remote Location Wait List A remote-location waiting-list category; do not compare its number directly with GNWL. RLWL 12 → WL 5 PQWL Pooled Quota Wait List A pooled-quota waiting-list category; read the actual current passenger status too. PQWL 7 → WL 3 TQWL Tatkal Quota Wait List A Tatkal waiting-list category; Tatkal does not make a waitlisted ticket confirmed. TQWL 8 → WL 4 All four examples are invented and unrelated; they are not live tickets, forecasts or a ranking. In ‘GNWL 24 → WL 9’, the booking began at 24 and the shown current position is 9; the passenger remains waitlisted. Movement does not establish a percentage or permission to travel. Check the official status and applicable ticket rules before boarding. Check each passenger’s PNR status What confirmation estimates can and cannot tell you Code definitions checked against Indian Railways PNR enquiry on 22 October 2026. Official PNR legend On this page What the four codes mean Read the prefix and number together Is GNWL always better than RLWL? Choose an option using your arrival deadline When should you check again? 01 What the four codes mean GNWL means General Wait List; RLWL means Remote Location Wait List; PQWL means Pooled Quota Wait List; TQWL means Tatkal Quota Wait List. The prefix identifies a waiting-list category. It is not an assurance that a particular passenger will receive a berth. 02 Read the prefix and number together For an illustrative booking GNWL/20 with current WL/8, the earlier and later positions describe different moments. The number is a queue position, not coach 8 or berth 8. Keep the train, date, class and boarding pair with the result. Looking at a cropped status screenshot without these details makes comparisons unreliable. Decode a status label 03 Is GNWL always better than RLWL? There is no universal ranking that proves an individual booking will confirm. Do not compare a small number in one category with a larger number in another as though they shared one queue. Compare the available alternatives for your actual trip and decide how much uncertainty you can accept. RailQ does not publish invented percentage chances from a prefix alone. 04 Choose an option using your arrival deadline If you must arrive for an exam, appointment or flight, start with that deadline and compare journeys with confirmed accommodation. A cheaper waitlisted option can become expensive if you later need emergency transport. Include station transfers, overnight accommodation and cancellation conditions in the comparison, not just ticket price. Compare train options 05 When should you check again? Check when making a travel decision and before leaving for the station. Repeated refreshing cannot improve the queue position. After charting, use the separate guide for your ticket type and passenger mix; understanding a category name does not by itself answer whether you may board. Check current PNR status Understand the confirmation percentage Understand waiting-list movement On this page One PNR can contain different outcomes Example: two adults on one booking Decide whether everyone or only some will travel Partial travel can need evidence Before cancelling selected passengers 01 One PNR can contain different outcomes A confirmed passenger does not make every other passenger confirmed. IRCTC treats a partially confirmed or partially RAC e-ticket differently from an entirely waitlisted e-ticket. Read all rows and the chart status. Chart inclusion is not the same as a separate berth allocation for a waitlisted companion. 02 Example: two adults on one booking Suppose passenger one shows CNF and passenger two shows WL. Keep a private two-row checklist: present status, assigned coach/berth, intended travel and the official action required. Do not copy passenger one’s berth into passenger two’s row. Recheck near departure because an earlier screenshot may no longer describe the booking. Read every passenger row 03 Decide whether everyone or only some will travel Discuss the actual accommodation before travelling, especially with children or older relatives. If nobody will travel, that differs from one passenger travelling and another staying home. Confirm the applicable process with the booking service before acting. Do not assume an unused companion’s fare will return automatically. 04 Partial travel can need evidence The published IRCTC document describes a ticket-checking certificate for some mixed-booking non-travel claims. Ask the official service what evidence and submission method apply now. Preserve the acknowledgement and any original document. Do not wait until you are home to ask what should have been recorded during the journey. 05 Before cancelling selected passengers Match names and row numbers carefully. Read the final screen, save the revised ticket and tell the travelling passengers which record is current. Do not publish the family ticket when asking for advice. h1: Ajmeri Gate, New Delhi Station: Entrance & Metro Guide
mainText: Home / Guides / Ajmeri Gate, New Delhi Station: Entrance & Metro Guide Practical journey guide Ajmeri Gate, New Delhi Station: Entrance & Metro Guide Choose the NDLS entrance for Metro, taxi or your hotel. Compare Ajmeri Gate and Paharganj, open labelled maps and plan your arrival. Source-aware guidance English and हिंदी Ajmeri Gate or Paharganj: which entrance? For the New Delhi Metro interchange (Yellow Line / Airport Express), plan around the Ajmeri Gate side. If you are coming from Paharganj or a hotel there, compare the Paharganj approach with your actual walking or taxi route. Both serve New Delhi railway station (NDLS). Neither entrance guarantees the shortest route to your platform. Choose by your approach, then verify today’s access Check Ajmeri Gate side Paharganj side Metro connection DMRC identifies the railway connection on the Ajmeri Gate side; its skywalk announcement connects the adjacent Metro lines. Do not assume the Metro exit is on this side. Check the route before crossing with luggage. Hotel / taxi arrival Tell the driver ‘NDLS, Ajmeri Gate side’ and confirm the current authorised drop-off. For a Paharganj address, compare this approach; tell the driver ‘NDLS, Paharganj side’. Platform and accessibility Confirm the platform on station displays. Gates, diversions, lifts and assistance can change; ask railway staff for the current step-free route. Google Maps: Ajmeri Gate entrance search Google Maps: Paharganj entrance search Before leaving: match NDLS on your ticket, choose the side with your driver, allow time for security and walking, and check signs on arrival. Map search results are orientation aids, not live gate-access instructions. Sources checked 22 October 2026: DMRC’s interchange guidance and its 4 March 2022 skywalk announcement. The announcement is not a live access notice. DMRC: interchanges · DMRC: skywalk announcement On this page Both names refer to approaches to NDLS Arriving by Metro Arriving by cab or meeting someone An entrance does not guarantee your platform For a train-to-flight connection 01 Both names refer to approaches to NDLS Ajmeri Gate and Paharganj describe different sides of New Delhi railway station, not two interchangeable taxi destinations. First confirm that your ticket says NDLS. If it says DLI, NZM or ANVT, you need another railway station, not a different entrance to New Delhi. Identify the correct Delhi station 02 Arriving by Metro DMRC documents the New Delhi Metro connection on the Yellow and Airport Express lines, with an Ajmeri Gate-side skywalk connection. Check the live Metro route and operating hours for your journey. The 2022 skywalk notice explains the connection but cannot guarantee today’s access restrictions, lift operation or crowd conditions. Follow current signs and staff directions. 03 Arriving by cab or meeting someone Send the station name, chosen side and a specific permitted meeting point to the driver. If you are staying near Paharganj, compare the actual walking or road route rather than changing your destination to Ajmeri Gate automatically. For a pickup, wait until you know which side you will exit. A message saying only “outside the station” is easy to misunderstand. 04 An entrance does not guarantee your platform Check the train display after entering and leave time to reach the assigned platform. Do not choose a side solely from an old platform prediction. With a wheelchair, pram or heavy luggage, ask about the usable step-free route before committing to a staircase. Accessibility planning is part of reaching the coach, not only reaching the station boundary. Check platform information 05 For a train-to-flight connection Include getting off the train, reaching the Metro or road pickup, airport-terminal access and the airline’s check-in deadline. An airport train connection does not erase the risk of a delayed incoming railway service. Check the airport terminal you need and keep an alternative if a delay would make the onward journey impractical.
